g.text: Sequence Diagram - AA02 Successful Google Sign-In (OIDC Authorization Code Flow + PKCE)
Success path only: linked, active account with at least one role.
Account-resolution outcomes (new account, inactive, no role, e-mail conflict): SD 2.
Cancellation, invalid payload and authentication failures: SD 3.
(login page, next to local login - AA01)
The Google password is entered only on Google's pages.
LaPrizza never receives, collects or stores it (AC 5).
{ provider: GOOGLE, subject, email, emailVerified, name }
expiresIn, user { id, name, email, roles, active, ... } }
keep the token as defined by AA04;
roles taken only from the back-end response (AA03)
navigate to the start page allowed
